name: @realadvisor/sites
description: RealAdvisor Sites: the data SDK, the Astro and React Router kits, the site template and twelve example sites.

scripts.test: pnpm --dir sdk test && pnpm --dir kit-core test
scripts.check:examples: pnpm --dir examples install && pnpm --dir examples check && pnpm --dir examples check:deploy
scripts.check:template:react: pnpm --dir template install && pnpm --dir template check && pnpm --dir template check:deploy
scripts.check:template:astro: pnpm --dir template-astro install && pnpm --dir template-astro check && pnpm --dir template-astro check:deploy
